none: PAS BM-76F010: Roman Coin: Radiate of Gordian III
contea di ritrovamento: Darlington (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ M TR P III COS II P P

A base-silver radiate, both a hybrid and a contemporary copy, of Gordian III dating to the period AD 241 to 243 (Reece period 12). P M TR P III COS II P P reverse type depicting Apollo seated left holding branch and resting elbow on lyre. As Mint of Rome. cf. RIC IV, Pt III, p. 25, no. 87 for reverse type.
